business_summary: Rentracks CO.,LTD. offers WEB consulting and Internet media services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Performance-Based Advertising Services Business; Managed Advertising Agency Business; Used Construction Machinery Marketplace Related Business; and Precious Metals Reuse, Processing, and Refining Business segments. The company's WEB consulting services include SEO, SEM, customer attraction website building, web production, and advertising agency services; and Internet media services comprise the planning, production, and operation of various websites. It also operates as a closed affiliate service provider; offers GAME FEAT, which provides advertising services to support monetization of game apps; Rentracks, a performance -based advertising service; and Growth Power for buying and selling of used construction machinery and other equipment. In addition, the company is involved in search advertising agency; management, trading, investment, and management of securities; sales agency for construction machinery; media planning and operation business; planning, development, and sales of compact home appliances; smelting business; clothing sale; performance-based advertising service; system development; and EC site management businesses. Further, it exports its products to Asia, the Middle East, the United States, and other countries. The company was formerly known as Coel Co, Ltd. and changed its name to Rentracks CO.,LTD. in January 2006. Rentracks CO.,LTD. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Edogawa, Japan.
